channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves’ losing streak hits four with 120-115 loss to Bulls
item.description: The Wolves led by four with 1:17 to play but didn’t score again, giving up the game’s final nine points.

item.title: Polaris to close Wisconsin plant, lay off 200 workers
item.description: The sale of the Indian Motorcycle business led to the Minnesota company’s decision to close the Osceola plant.

item.title: Brutal cold will hike natural gas prices for some in Minnesota
item.description: Xcel Energy and CenterPoint Energy are both urging customers to conserve energy to save money.

item.title: Takeaways: Kirill Kaprizov’s second goal gives Wild 4-3 overtime victory over Red Wings
item.description: The Wild ended their home losing streak thanks to their star forward ending his streak without a goal.

item.title: Congress grills UnitedHealth CEO Stephen Hemsley on claim denials, insurance costs
item.description: Lawmakers questioned the Eden Prairie-based company’s business practices and whether its large size adds to affordability troubles.

item.title: Nisswa City Council passes vote of no confidence in Mayor Jennifer Carnahan
item.description: In a surprise move, Carnahan moved to adopt the resolution herself, even as she called it ‘very thin.’

item.title: Minnesota prisons chief accuses Homeland Security of peddling ‘misinformation’ on ICE surge
item.description: Corrections Commissioner Paul Schnell offered video evidence to refute DHS claims, suggesting it’s spreading “pure propaganda.”

item.title: After 15 days, county medical examiner classifies Renee Good’s death as homicide
item.description: Homicide means the death came at the hands of another person and does not necessarily mean the person died from a criminal act.

item.title: Detainment of 5-year-old boy draws international attention and support for his family
item.description: A Columbia Heights preschooler was detained this week with his father outside their home. They remain in a Texas detention facility.

item.title: The latest: Economic blackout planned across Minnesota on Friday
item.description: During a visit to the state, Vice President JD Vance said to “come out and protest, protest me, protest our immigration policy, but do it peacefully.”
